abstract: Forty patients with retroperitoneal metastasis from nonseminomatous testicular cancer treated with chemotherapy were retrospectively studied to (1) evaluate the predictive value of mass size as detected by computerized tomography (CT) as an indicator for postchemotherapy surgery and (2) determine the factors that influence relapse. Patients received two further courses of chemotherapy after their serum biomarkers became normal and computed tomography indicated a complete response or presence of a residual but stable mass. We found that patients with initial metastases less than 2 cm had a low frequency (14%) of residual masses after chemotherapy, vs. 59% for those with masses of 2-5 cm and 75% for those with masses of greater than 5 cm (P = 0.03). Of 22 patients with primary embryonal carcinoma, three of seven (43%) with residual masses after chemotherapy had mature teratoma at surgery. Six patients had small (1-2 cm) residual abnormalities that were not removed, and three of these patients relapsed. In conclusion, increasing size of retroperitoneal metastasis by CT scan predicts for increased likelihood of a residual mass after chemotherapy; patients who have a residual mass greater than or equal to 1 cm require retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy after chemotherapy, whether the tumor histology is embryonal carcinoma or teratoma. The role of surgery for patients who have residual retroperitoneal masses less than 1 cm after chemotherapy could not be determined from our study.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんによる後腹膜転移を有し化学療法を受けた40例を後方視的に検討し、(1)腫瘤サイズのCTによる評価が化学療法後の手術適応の予測指標となるか、(2)再発に影響する因子は何かを評価した。血清腫瘍マーカーが正常化し、CTで完全奏効あるいは安定した残存腫瘤が確認された後、さらに2コースの化学療法を行った。初診時転移が2cm未満の患者では化学療法後の残存腫瘤の頻度が低かった（14%）のに対し、2〜5cmでは59%、5cm超では75%であった（P = 0.03）。原発胎児性癌の22例のうち、化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有した7例中3例（43%）で、手術時に成熟奇形腫がみられた。残存病変が1〜2cmと小さかった6例は切除されず、そのうち3例が再発した。結論として、CTで評価した後腹膜転移の増大は、化学療法後に残存腫瘤が生じる可能性の増加を予測する。化学療法後に1cm以上の残存腫瘤がある患者は、組織型が胎児性癌か奇形腫かにかかわらず後腹膜リンパ節郭清が必要である。化学療法後に1cm未満の残存後腹膜腫瘤がある患者に対する手術の役割は、本研究では決定できなかった。
